headline: Saregama India grants 10.50 lakh stock options to eligible employees
hook: Employee stock option pool expanded at Saregama
summary: Saregama India has announced the grant of 10.50 lakh stock options to eligible employees under its existing employee stock option schemes. ESOP grants dilute existing equity slightly, which is a standard corporate practice for talent retention and alignment of employee interests with shareholder value. For Indian retail investors holding the stock, this represents a minor dilution event rather than an immediate financial or operational catalyst.
why_it_matters: Minor equity dilution for existing shareholders.
